title: Replace the fast-tier committee
body: Replaces the fast-tier committee. Needs a new DKG ceremony first: Committee is a JSON list of member wallets, Share-Public-Keys a JSON list in the same order, Group-Key the new group key, Threshold at least 2. Old members keep their earned fees. It moves money or code, so it carries Effective-At (filled by dao-propose: the vote's end + 24 h + 1 day of margin); it takes effect only then, when anyone sends Gov.Apply, and until then validators may leave by the exit hatch (Exit-Now) and the DAO may cancel it (Gov.Cancel).
